name: CSO_NORMALIZED_QUESTIONS
description: Dimension table to hold normalized questions.

columns.name: NORMALIZED_QUESTION_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the table. Populated by sequence number.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: NORMALIZED_QUESTION
columns.description: The question text after it has been normalized.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: This is the reference to the locale in CSO_LOCALE table.

columns.name: RECOGNIZED_TOKENS
columns.description: List of known words or concepts to the search application.

columns.name: UNRECOGNIZED_TOKENS
columns.description: List of unknown words to the search application.

columns.name: RECOGNIZED_TOKENS_CSV
columns.description: List of known words or concepts to the search application. This list is used by PLSQL code to generate tokens.

columns.name: UNRECOGNIZED_TOKENS_CSV
columns.description: List of unknown words to the search application. This list is used by PLSQL code to generate tokens.

columns.name: DEPARTMENT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID for the department as stored by knowledge and will be used for striping questions.
